purpose: Establish, before any H100 is rented, that the packet's ladder is executable rather than merely written. Two classes of failure are cheap to find here and expensive to find on a metered GPU: an argument vector the benchmark CLI rejects, and an end-to-end run that cannot find a packed dataset.

defects_found_and_fixed.defect: The command field was a prose template whose `--profile {profile}` hole was filled with the boolean true by the profile run. The flag takes a trace path, so argparse raises TypeError on a non-string and the run would have died after the ladder had already been paid for.
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: Every run now records a machine-generated argv, and the profile override is a trace path. experiments/qualification/check_throughput_packet.py rejects a boolean before argv is built.

defects_found_and_fixed.defect: The h100-best-endtoend run switches to end-to-end mode, which loads a packed manifest, but no run or prerequisite supplied --data-dir. The parser would have silently fallen back to ~/.cache/speck/benchmark-200m, which does not exist on a fresh rented host, so the one run that re-measures the overhead derate would have failed.
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: common.data_dir points at the bundle's pilot-data directory and the checker fails any end-to-end run without an explicit --data-dir.

defects_found_and_fixed.defect: Nothing bound the packet to the CLI, so a renamed flag would have been discovered during the rental.
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: check_throughput_packet.py parses every run with the real parser, asserts the parsed values equal the declared overrides, and runs inside `make plan-check` and the test suite.

what_this_proves: The flagship 1.2B reference geometry instantiates and steps at sequence length 4096 under the packet's eager, activation-checkpointed baseline configuration, at the declared 1,195,884,576 parameters.

end-to-end mode loads the real packed 105M pilot manifest and trains on it. The first-step loss of 10.74 against the synthetic run's 4.42 is the evidence that real tokens were read rather than random ones.
The packed manifest contains no absolute paths, so it relocates onto a rented host.
what_this_does_not_establish: No H100 or GH200 result, no flagship speedup and no model FLOPs utilization that transfers. These runs used two measured steps on an sm_86 card at a placeholder 71.0 peak-TFLOPS figure; the utilization numbers describe the 3090 and nothing else.

No checkpointing-off flagship configuration was attempted: peak reserved memory already reached 21.94 GiB of the card's 24 GiB with checkpointing on, which is why the checkpointing-off measurement is what the rental exists to obtain.
No microbatch above one, no compiled path, no clock-stability band and no overhead derate. All of those belong to the rental.

operator_inputs_still_required: An 80 GiB H100 SXM instance with one allocated GPU, its instance ID, hourly rate, storage and network charges, and an intended deletion time.
SSH host, port and user for the transfer and the run.
A declared rental spend ceiling, so the packet's stop condition has a number.

funding.boundary: Local pre-flight ran on an owned RTX 3090 and consumed no grant hours and no rental spend.

boundary: Argument-handling and executability evidence only. It establishes no throughput result, no data eligibility, no model quality and no authorization to train.
